page.overview:
What is Overkill?

Overkill is the thirteenth track from Metallica's cover album Garage, Inc. Disc 2.

Originally released by Motörhead in 1979 on the album of the same name, Metallica have already released their version in their 1996's Until It Sleeps single. Its also featured on the Hero of the Day single.

Only way to feel the noise Is when it's good and loud So good you can't believe It's screaming with the crowd

Don't sweat it Get it back to you Don't sweat it Get it back to you
